📋 Assessments & Fabrication

Precise Assessments & On-Site Fabrication

Every device starts with a thorough evaluation and ends in our own lab — so fit, function, and turnaround are all in our hands.

How It Works

1

Clinical Assessment

Full bio-mechanical evaluation and medical history review.

2

Measurement & Casting

Precise measurements and impressions are taken for your device.

3

In-House Fabrication

Your device is built in our on-site lab for speed and quality control.

4

Fitting & Adjustment

A test fitting confirms comfort and function before your final device is dispensed.

Why in-house fabrication matters.

Building devices on-site means faster turnaround, closer quality control, and the ability to make same-visit adjustments when something isn't quite right.

We also follow up after fitting — for fitment issues, device breakage, or simply making sure your device is working the way it should.

Start with a free assessment.

We'll walk you through the full process, step by step.
